[Featured Project]

Recent Renovation: Mississauga Full Home Remodel

Mississauga Full Home Remodel - Bosco Cabinetry

This stunning Toronto home renovation showcases 2,100+ sq ft of expertly crafted custom kitchen cabinets and built-in storage solutions. Our team delivered a complete kitchen remodel featuring premium quartz countertops, custom cabinetry with undermount lighting, and a show-stopping double waterfall island that serves as the centerpiece of this modern family home.

This full home renovation included custom built-in closets for every bedroom, creating seamless storage solutions that maximize space and functionality. Our custom millwork extends throughout the main living areas, including a bespoke feature wall with integrated electric fireplace and entertainment center, complemented by natural red oak hardwood flooring throughout.

From the versatile basement apartment kitchen renovation to sophisticated bathroom vanities and built-in storage throughout multiple levels, this project demonstrates our expertise in residential cabinetry and custom home renovations. Every detail reflects Bosco Cabinetry's commitment to quality craftsmanship and functional design that transforms houses into dream homes.

[Our Process]

From Concept to Completion in 4 Simple Steps

Our proven process ensures every project is delivered on time, on budget, and exceeds your expectations.

Quality craftsmanship in our North York facility

01

Free Consultation

We visit your home to discuss your vision, measure your space, and understand your budget and timeline preferences.

02

Design & Quote

04

Installation

Our certified installers complete your project with meticulous attention to detail and thorough cleanup.

[FAQ]

Frequently Asked Questions

Get answers to common questions about our custom cabinetry process, pricing, and services.

Most kitchen cabinet projects are completed 4-6 weeks from approval. This includes 3-4 weeks for manufacturing in our North York facility and 1-2 weeks for professional installation. Timeline may vary based on project complexity and customization requirements.

Our complimentary in-home consultation includes professional space assessment, style and finish recommendations, 3D design concepts, and a detailed quote with transparent pricing. We also discuss your timeline, budget, and any special requirements during this visit.

Yes, we provide flexible financing solutions to make your dream kitchen or closet more accessible. We work with several financing partners to offer competitive rates and payment plans that fit your budget. Contact us to discuss available options.

We stand behind our craftsmanship with a comprehensive 2-year warranty on all installation work and manufacturing defects. Our European hardware comes with manufacturer warranties, and we provide ongoing support for any issues that may arise.

Absolutely! We specialize in maximizing your current space, whether you want to keep the existing layout or make modifications. Our designers will assess your space and recommend the best approach to achieve your goals within your budget.

Our combination of affordable luxury, 20+ years experience, massive 5,500 sq ft showroom, and full-service approach sets us apart. We handle everything from design to installation, use premium European hardware, and offer over 100 finish options at competitive prices.

Pricing varies based on size, materials, finishes, and complexity. Kitchen cabinet projects typically start around $15,000 and can range up to $50,000+ for luxury installations. We provide detailed, transparent quotes with no hidden fees during your free consultation.

We assist with permit applications when required and ensure all work meets local building codes. For major renovations involving electrical or plumbing changes, we coordinate with licensed contractors and handle inspection scheduling as needed.
